theorems.name: Submission.cmc_flat_convergence
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (Ts : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), IsOpen U → (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Ts j)) → IsIntegerMultiplicity T → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → ⨆ j, ((Ts j).massOn W + (Ts j).boundary.massOn W) < ∞) → WeaklyConvergesOn Ts T → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → ∃ (R : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 2)) (S : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (R j) ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity (S j) ∧ T - Ts j - S j = (R j).boundary) ∧ Tendsto (fun j => (R j).massOn W + (S j).massOn W) atTop (𝓝 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
